Department: Support Operations

Reports To: Director, Support Operations

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Clinical Coordinators through clear priorities, delegation, accountability, and follow-through
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, coaching, and ongoing training refreshers
  • Oversee team scheduling, workload balancing, and coverage across markets based on provider days, appointment volume, and overall workload
  • Support onboarding and competency development for new team members
  • Foster a positive, efficient, and collaborative culture grounded in service excellence and ownership

Appointment Readiness & Schedule Reliability

  • Monitor the 0-14-day schedule and upcoming weeks to identify open capacity, underfilled provider days, and scheduling risks early
  • Ensure accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked in accordance with provider availability, market zoning, and scheduling priorities
  • Ensure Clinical Coordinators identify, track, and escalate scheduling barriers, including outstanding medical clearances, insurance verification, pre-medication needs, facility documentation, and lab-case concerns, to the appropriate department or owner
  • Monitor Clinical Days at Goal and schedule disruptions to ensure timely follow-up and improve filled provider days across applicable markets
  • Ensure schedules are entered timely and accurately while production-based scheduling remains focused appropriately

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze recurring scheduling barriers, backlog trends, fall-aparts, and schedule-health concerns to identify operational gaps and root causes
  • Develop preventive strategies and implement workflow or SOP improvements within Clinical Coordination
  • Coordinate any workflow change affecting another department or external partner with the appropriate department leader or Account Manager before implementation
  • Support system optimization, automation initiatives, and process refinements in CareStack and Healier

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner across departments to resolve scheduling barriers, maintain clear ownership, and support consistent patient flow
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex scheduling needs or facility and provider concerns
  • Independently address department concerns, communicate risks and updates, and escalate to the Director when additional leadership support is needed

Data, Reporting & Accountability

  • Monitor and report team performance and operational health indicators, including:
  • Clinical Days at Goal
  • 0-14-day schedule health and upcoming provider weeks
  • Accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlog progress
  • Schedule-entry timeliness
  • Reschedule, cancellation, and fall-apart trends
  • Outstanding scheduling barriers and escalations
  • Provide weekly insights, actions taken, next steps, and performance updates to leadership
  • Ensure accurate documentation standards in CareStack and Healier

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in dental, medical, or clinical scheduling/coordination; minimum 2 years leadership experience
  • Systems: Experience with CareStack, or similar EMR platforms and Google Suite required
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success managing remote teams, assigning and delegating work, coaching performance, holding employees accountable, and implementing process improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
    • Strong organizational, delegation, and prioritization abilities
    • Ability to independently assess problems, make decisions, and follow through
    • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment
Key Competencies

  • Leadership & team development
  • Delegation, accountability & follow-through
  • Proactive problem solving & root-cause thinking
  • Schedule-health oversight & workload management
  • Workflow optimization & accuracy
  • Efficient decision-making & prioritization
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Service-minded communication with professionalism and empathy

Work Environment

  • Fully remote role requiring reliable internet access
  • Requires ongoing communication with team members, facilities, providers, and internal departments via virtual platforms
  • Occasional travel for leadership meetings, in-field shadow sessions, or training as needed

Benefits

Compensation: Base compensation $60,000-65,000 annually

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Life Insurance, Paid Time Off

TIMBERTEK is a Dubai-based wood flooring company specializing in solid wood flooring installation, restoration, maintenance, sanding, and polishing for premium residential and hospitality projects.

Position Summary Balco is seeking a dynamic, motivated, and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead and grow sales of our architectural product lines across the Western Half of the United States. This is a high-impact leadership role for a sales professional who thrives in the architectural building products space and is energized by building teams, driving growth, and influencing complex construction projects from design through installation. The RSM will lead a network of direct sales professionals and independent manufacturer representatives while serving as a key market ambassador for Balcoâs portfolio of architectural engineered products for the construction industry. Categories include expansion joint systems, stair nosings, entrance mats & grids, photoluminescent egress systems, etc. The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership with technical acumen to guide product selection based on project-specific conditions, ensuring Balco solutions are specified and installed successfully in competitive bid environments. This role combines strategic leadership, hands-on selling and technical support, and rigorous performance management to deliver profitable growth and exceptional customer experiences. Responsibilities Drive year-over-year revenue growth to meet or exceed sales budgets across assigned territories and product lines. Build, coach, and lead a high-performing sales organization consisting of direct sales employees and independent manufacturer representatives, setting clear goals and driving accountability across both groups. Provide technical guidance and support to sales team members and customers, including analyzing project conditions, recommending appropriate Balco products (e.g., expansion joint systems, stair nosings, photoluminescent egress markings), and assisting with submittals and specifications. Develop and implement competitive strategies to increase Balco specification rates and market share, including targeted initiatives with architects, contractors, and distributors. Maintain deep knowledge of the competitive landscape, including products, pricing, and market dynamics, to win specification and project opportunities. Track and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitive activities using CRM tools; prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports.â¯ Deliver sales and product knowledge presentations to architects, contractors, trade groups, and other stakeholders. Lead and support complex negotiations to secure profitable, strategic opportunities. Partner closely with Customer Service, Technical Services, and internal leadership to ensure outstanding execution and customer satisfaction. Establish clear expectations, regularly track, and review performance metrics, proactively address gaps through coaching and development plans, and recognize/reward wins and best practices. Expand and strengthen relationships with existing customers, contractors, distributors, architects, design engineers, and other key influencers across the full sales territory. Strong executive presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Highly relationship-driven with the ability to influence across multiple stakeholders and decision-makers. Strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong customer-first approach. Skilled negotiator comfortable managing complex, multi-party sales scenarios. Confident presenter capable of delivering impactful sales and technical presentations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM/order management systems, including Salesforce. Able to communicate effectively and professionally with team members and customers verbally and in writing. Able to complete work accurately and on time. Able to work collaboratively with direct team members, or across departments, and work independently as needed. Able to effectively lead a team by providing direction, measuring quality of work, giving feedback, and managing performance. Candidates who apply for positions that require driving must have a valid U.S. driverâs license and clean driving record. Bachelorâs degree in Business, Marketing, or related field preferred. Experience 5+ years of progressive experience in sales, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. Work Environment Physical Conditions: Field: This position requires the ability to visit construction sites from time to time and utilize the required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), i.e.: hard hat, eye/face protection, hearing protection, steel toes, etc. Remote: This is remote role. Remote employees are required to have a dedicated work space where they can conduct business and have private conversations. Other Requirements Candidates who receive an offer of employment must successfully pass a background check and drug screen. This role requires driving for the Company, so candidates who receive an offer of employment for this role must have a current driverâs license and have a clean MVR. Each year, Audacious selects a cohort of extraordinary leaders from around the world â visionaries with proximity to the problems they're solving, and bold plans to shift systems, lift up communities, and contribute to a healthier planet. Since its launch in 2018, Audacious has helped to catalyze more than $8B for over 70 projects across a range of issue areas.   • Approaching an inflection point or needing a significant capital inflow to catalyze a differentiated level of impact that they havenât received support for yet (rather than support for ongoing operations)
  • Thoughtfully ambitious ideas that both inspire and convince â have an exciting, breakthrough vision (âinspireâ), clear outcomes, and evidence that the idea will have a significant and concrete impact (âconvinceâ)

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and evolve the sourcing and curation strategy.
  • Advance sourcing and curation strategy for each cycle, forming a clear point of view on where Audacious should be learning, looking, collaborating, and why, ultimately carrying that strategy forward across cycles
  • Develop a âfuture-orientedâ approach by monitoring and anticipating emerging trends and innovations that Audacious actively engages with or responds to
  • Actively capture insights and lessons learned to refine and improve Audacious's sourcing and curation activities annually
  • Lead selection and diligence.
  • Apply the sourcing and curation strategy to identify the ideas most worth Audacious's attention - deciding what advances into the application stage, and bringing along multiple stakeholders and inputs along that decision-making process
  • Lead diligence on selected organizations, rigorously testing readiness, viability, and fit within Audacious's portfolio
  • Build the recommendation â evidence, rationale, and risks included â that carries an idea into finalist selection
  • Cultivate and steward the partners who bring ideas to Audacious.
  • Surface strong ideas by building genuine, ongoing relationships with social sector leaders, including funder and intermediary partners (incl. sourcing networks, collaboratives, and others)
  • Steward key partner relationships by developing a deep understanding of each stakeholderâs goals, priorities, and aspirations
  • Maintain stakeholder relationships continuously, within and across cycles, to ensure trust and rapport among all actors
  • Represent Audacious's point of view in the field, using that standing to draw the most ambitious organizations and ideas toward the platform and to create richer opportunities for sector collaboration
  • Build and nurture a team that explores the frontier of audacious social change.
  • Lead the Discovery and Insight vertical and its resourcing strategically, matching capacity to where the real work sits and bringing in the right technical expertise when needed
  • Develop people who can source, diligence, and hold partner relationships credibly in their own right â building a team of strong practitioners so Audacious's discovery capacity grows beyond any single person
  • Effectively steward relationships and actively collaborate with key Audacious partners (e.g., The Bridgespan Group) with whom we partner year-round

Qualifications

Career and Functional Experience

Essential

  • A leader who has set strategy in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments, and who can hold their own in rooms both with ultra-high net worth individuals and issue experts and with their own team, making consequential decisions grounded in clear principles and with conviction
  • Strong generalist fluency across geographic, social-change and innovation domains with the maturity and credibility to engage experts across them
  • Experience building and developing teams, leading change management efforts, and operating through influence across a senior leadership group

What Success Looks Like

  • A clear, evolving sense of what belongs in Audacious's portfolio â built from what selection and diligence have taught, not assumed upfront
  • A network of donors and partners who stay engaged and where relationships are nurtured from inception, and where trust, learning, and respect are built over time
  • Recommendations reaching the Executive Director hold up because the diligence, learning, and collaboration behind them are real and rigorous

title: Compatibility
description: CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common. The right people donât always think theyâre right Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness. The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit. We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Who is Stripe for? Ambitious builders Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Adaptable problem solvers AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. Rigorous thinkers We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard. The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know. Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA What all Stripes have in common Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on. Motivated by our mission Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet. Ask Yourself: Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress? Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents? Embody our operating principles âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously. Ask Yourself: Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe? Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities? Energized by change The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does. Ask Yourself: Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle? Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience? Collaborative, multidisciplinary work Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically. Ask Yourself: Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale? How we operate Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same. Users first We serve millions of businesses and a meaningful fraction of global GDP. We have a weighty responsibility to those businesses and to society. We work backwards from our usersâ needs, indexing especially on feedback from the most innovative. Everyone at Stripe talks to users. Create with craft and beauty With careful thought, anything can be made surprisingly great. Across every part of Stripe, we are committed to doing so. Well-crafted work indicates care for the user, and beautiful work indicates care for the world. Move with urgency and focus We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow. Whereas many companies get slower until theyâre eventually mired in mediocrity, we aspire to become the worldâs fastest company. Collaborate egolessly We work as one team: no fiefdoms, no hoarding information, no ânot my problem.â We question assumptions, debate energetically, and abandon ideas when better ones emerge. Weâre generous with credit and stingy with blame. We learn from mistakes together. Stay curious Stripe is an applied exercise in learning about how businesses tick and how the world works. Since the details and possibilities are infinite, we are always seeking to learn. Weâre energized by the unfamiliar, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Obsess over talent Itâs every Stripeâs responsibility to help hire the best and to push for excellence everywhere. Managers must relentlessly uphold our high talent bar, lead their teams with clarity and context, foster development, and ultimately support Stripes in accomplishing the best work of their careers. Our culture Like all great workplaces, Stripe has its own working culture, with norms that can surprise, delight, and occasionally perplex. Friday Fireside Friday Fireside is a weekly Stripe-wide forum hosted by Patrick and John. We hear from a Stripe user and get their unvarnished feedback, invite Stripes to chat about (or demo!) their recent work, and welcome external experts to discuss timely and relevant topics. Convergence Every December, Stripes come together for Convergenceâa full-day event and Stripe tradition dating back to 2014. Itâs a chance to reflect on the past year, hear about our priorities for the next year, learn from each other, and poke fun at ourselves. How we show up in the world Cheeky Pint Ideas meet the pub hang. In this podcast series, John Collison sits down with founders, builders, and leaders to discuss their craft over a pint. Watch Cheeky Pint Stripe Press Stripe Press publishes books about ideas for economic, technological, and scientific progress. We print works we think can be broadly useful. Find Stripe Press titles Works in Progress Stripeâs online and print magazine focuses on scientific, technological and economic advancement. Read about Works in Progress Frontier Launched in 2022, Frontier is Stripeâs advance market commitment to buy an initial $1.8B of permanent carbon removal by 2040. Learn about Frontier Intercept A new initiative focused on dramatically reducing the burden of respiratory viruses. Learn about Intercept Frequently asked questions What is it actually like to work at Stripe day to day? Fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and creative. The volume is high, and the problems are high stakes. But you wonât be doing it aloneâwe work with egoless collaboration. Most Stripes will tell you the caliber of their teammates is one of the things they value most, and that it raises their own standard of work. How does Stripe invest in your growth? Through the work itself, mostly. Stripe gives people stretch projects early, which means youâre solving problems that are hard and consequential to the business. Beyond that, we offer mentorship, direct feedback, and an annual education stipend for courses, conferences, and resources that move your career forward. The expectation is that youâll grow quickly here. Weâre set up to support you. How does AI shape the work here? AI is embedded in how everyone at Stripe builds, analyzes, and operates. Engineers use AI tools daily to accelerate development. Teams across product, design, and operations are building AI-powered features for the businesses and consumers who rely on Stripe. We think carefully about where AI creates real value versus where it introduces risk. What does it mean to do your best work here? Stripe is a place to do career-defining work. The stakes are high: millions of businesses rely on Stripe. Itâs a responsibility that requires combining urgency with high standards, an often demanding mix. In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy. More on careers at Stripe Get our perspective on why what we build matters. Opportunity Start your career at the center of the global economyâsee what we offer for early career opportunities. title: Menu
description: As Abraham Lincoln once said, âThe best way to predict the future is to create it.â If you want to advance your career but donât know where to start, here are some things you can do to get promoted at work. By Michele Reynolds Be a Model Employee Rule number one for being a good employee is to always be on time and ready to go. Even if you work in a culture that runs behind schedule, itâs better to be on timeâor even earlyâeach day and to every meeting. If youâre leading the meeting, show up with an agenda and be an active timekeeper. Itâs a sign that youâre organized, respect peopleâs time, and serve as a role model to peers. At the end of the meeting, give a quick recap and identify next steps. Solve Problems, Donât Just Identify Them One of the best ways to stand out as a budding leaderâregardless of your current roleâis to be self-sufficient and demonstrate solid judgment. Doing so wonât just set you apart as a critical asset to your team but also serve as a tactic to further develop your leadership skills. A helpful mantra is, âBe a problem solver, not a problem identifier.â When you raise an issue to your boss, also propose a solution. Busy leaders often get bogged down by solving every problem their team faces. Do your boss a favor and find workarounds rather than just surface issues. Respect Your Bossâs Time Be considerate of your bossâs time. Before asking for help, consider the level of urgency and try solving the problemâor at least brainstorm a plan of action to run by your manager. Making an attempt first will demonstrate you know how to take initiative. For things that require your bossâs intervention but arenât time-sensitive, keep a running list of items to discuss. Ask if you can get some time on your managerâs calendar and outline what youâd like to discuss in your meeting invite so you both come prepared. Donât Be a Squeaky Wheel Perhaps most important is a can-do attitude. Anything you can do to minimize your bossâs workload will likely benefit you in the long run. You can help by volunteering to take on something new or brainstorm solutions when a crisis pops up. Baseball great Wade Boggs once said, âA positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events, and outcomes. Itâs a catalyst, and it sparks extraordinary results.â So, whatever you do, donât be a whiner. Even if youâre feeling stressed, save your venting for a friend and present a positive front to your boss. Serve as a Vault Earn trust by keeping information about confidential or sensitive subjects to yourself. Beyond that, donât gossip or backstab at the water cooler. By being a stand-up employee, youâll earn trust and respect. Make Your Boss Look Good Staying organized and moving quickly can make you, and your boss, look good. But donât move too fast. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.

  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.

  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

We train and manage healthcare graduates to conduct remote, telephonic patient interactions using our purpose-built software. The result: patients receive timely support, healthcare organizations extend their capacity, and you gain real clinical experience.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">THE ROLE</strong></span></h5><p><span>As a GFH Patient Outreach Specialist, you'll conduct structured phone-based interactions with patients on behalf of our partner healthcare organizations. Using our software, you'll follow evidence-informed protocols to check in on patients, complete assessments, and escalate concerns when needed, all from a quiet space of your choosing. You'll work with patients experiencing different disease states, preventative care needs, medication use, post-discharge follow-up needs, etc. All interactions are telephonic; no video, no in-person contact required. Must be based in the U.S.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Complete a minimum of 20 hours of patient outreach per week on a flexible schedule you build</span></p></li><li><p><span>Conduct structured telephonic assessments and wellness check-ins using The Grove (Grapefruit Healthâs platform)</span></p></li><li><p><span>Document interaction outcomes accurately within the platform</span></p></li><li><p><span>Escalate patient safety concerns to a licensed clinical supervisor in real time</span></p></li><li><p><span>Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times</span></p></li><li><p><span>Participate in onboarding training and ongoing check-ins</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">TRAINING & SUPERVISION</strong></span></h5><p><span>All new graduate hires complete a â¦14 day paid onboarding covering our platform, communication frameworks, and HIPAA requirements. Once active, you'll be supervised by our Clinical Leadership Team who are available during your shifts for escalations and support.</span></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT YOU'LL GAIN</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>Verifiable healthcare experience for your resume</span></p></li><li><p><span>Confidence and fluency in patient communication</span></p></li><li><p><span>Familiarity with a real clinical software used in professional settings</span></p></li><li><p><span>The satisfaction of genuinely improving patient outcomes</span></p></li></ul><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></span></h5><ul><li><p><span>U.S. based required</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must be a healthcare school graduate â active clinical enrollment does not qualify for this role. You will be rejected if you are in school</span></p></li><li><p><span>Certification as a medical assistant, community health worker, patient navigator, pharmacy technician, or comparable clinical credential is a plus</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must have a compatible computer and cell phone with SMS</span></p></li><li><p><span>Must be able to work at least 20 hours/week</span></p></li><li><p><span>A quiet, private workspace free of background noise or distractions</span></p></li><li><p><span>Strong verbal communication skills, or a genuine desire to develop them</span></p></li><li><p><span>Comfort working independently in a remote environment</span></p></li></ul><p>If you are passionate about helping others and have a knack for building relationships, we encourage you to apply!</p><p></p><h5><strong><em>Required with Submission</em></strong></h5><ul><li><p><strong><em>Two-minute or less video explaining why you would be a good fit for Grapefruit Health and why you think learning how to perform care telephonically is important to prepare you to become a clinician. These do not need to be very formal and are mostly for us to evaluate your communication style. Be yourself and have fun with it!</em></strong></p></li></ul><p></p><h5><span><strong id="docs-internal-guid-9ce6a45c-7fff-b3a4-432d-8169b305997a">HEAR FROM OUR TEAM</strong></span></h5><p><span>âIâve had an amazing experience so far with Grapefruit. I am very thankful for this opportunity, and it has boosted my confidence as a future health care professional and with patient interactions.â -Madison, Pharmacy Student</span></p><p><span>âWorking with Grapefruit Health gave me the opportunity to communicate with real life patients. This program not only gave me the experience I was missing, but also the communication skills that I will carry with me into my career as a nurseâ-Elizabeth, Nursing Student</span></p><hr><p><span>Grapefruit Health is an equal opportunity employer. Students work directly for Grapefruit Healthââwe are not a third-party recruiter. All patient data is handled in accordance with HIPAA.</span></p>

description: Description Join Our Team as a Remote Experienced and Licensed Customer Service Representative! Within our Customer Response Center, the Remote Customer Service Representative provides timely, accurate and responsive information and service to policyholders and agents for a division of Personal Lines products, plans and programs. Independently solve problems relating to policies within scope and escalate others as appropriate. Identifies, analyzes, and owns customer policy needs to ensure high customer satisfaction, growth and retention of business. Training: Paid training is Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm EST (full time). Training is a critical component to your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory for success in this role. Shift: After onboarding and training is complete, go-forward shifts will have a start time between Shift hours 8:30 am -10:30 am EST with a weekend rotation. One weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) will be required with an alternate day off mid-week when working the weekend. Work Location: All equipment is provided. However, to work from home you must have dependable, wired internet connectivity with an upload speed of at least 5Mbps and a download speed of at least 25Mbps along with a quiet, secure, distraction free place to work. License: Active P&C Producers insurance license REQUIRED. We are currently not hiring in NY, CA, AK, HI, NM or IL. Qualifications Associates degree or 1+ year Insurance experience preferred. 2 years'+ related Customer Service experience is required. Ability to review, record and organize written data from a variety of sources with no prescribed format is essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. P&C Producers insurance license required. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.
